summary.text: Robert F. Kennedy, Jr., said the AI revolution is changing work and life and raised the challenge of ensuring it does not change what makes people human. In his HHS role, he said the department is already using AI to manage health care data and is deploying cutting-edge AI to detect fraud before payments leave the Treasury. He also described harnessing AI to quicken clinical trials, promote health care innovation, and support rural care, and said HHS is becoming a template for AI use.
